hero.lede: Your faculty's past papers, your course spaces and your practice, all in one place.
hero.statusNote: Document analysis: announced, not open yet.

features.intro: What the platform actually does today — no waiting list, no promise of a feature that is not there yet.
features.oneText: Past exams and course material sorted by faculty, department, level and year — the structure of your syllabus, not a shared folder.
features.twoText: A lecture-hall code to share in class, with the material, the announcements and the submissions gathered in a single class.
features.threeText: Questions drawn from your material, corrected on your device, with the points to revisit grouped by subject.

ai.lede: You add a course, a tutorial or a past paper; the key points are extracted and turned into questions you review before practising. Document analysis is not open yet — practice sessions already are.
ai.step1Text: A course document, a revision sheet or a past paper.
ai.step2Text: The suggested questions, to correct or to keep.
ai.step3Text: Weak points come back in the next session.

exams.lede: The room records what happens in it, but the decision stays human: Campusly never cancels a grade and never sanctions anyone automatically.
exams.itemAText: The timer is set by the teacher, never by the student.
exams.itemBText: A full-screen space, opened with the exam code.
exams.itemCText: Tab switches stay on the device, reviewed by the teacher.
exams.itemDText: Everyone gets their copy back, with the comments received.

faq.a1: Browse your faculty's past papers, join a class with a lecture-hall code, practise and keep track of the points that need work.
faq.a2: Not yet. Document analysis is marked “in preparation” everywhere it appears, including on this page.
faq.q3: Do I have to pay anything?
faq.a3: No. Credit packs are not open and no price is published before payments are switched on.
faq.a4: In this version everything you enter stays on your device: nothing is sent to a server.
faq.a5: No. It is an independent project: it is neither published nor officially approved by the University of Abomey-Calavi.

pages.notice: The French version of this document is authoritative. Other languages are provided for comprehension.
pages.aboutLede: Bringing UAC's academic resources together and making them usable from a single place.
pages.aboutWhyBody: Past papers, lecture handouts and model answers already exist: they circulate in messaging groups, on USB sticks and in shared folders that eventually get lost. Campusly files them the way the university's own programme structure does, so a first-year student finds the same thing as a fifth-year student.
pages.aboutOffer1: Past papers sorted by faculty, department, level and year.
pages.aboutOffer2: One course space per subject, opened with a lecture-hall code.
pages.aboutOffer3: Practice sets marked on your own device, with the topics to revise.
pages.aboutStateBody: This version shows the complete interface with sample data. Nothing is stored on a server. Question generation is not open, no payment is accepted, and the library will open with its first files.
pages.aboutContactBody: A question, a suggestion, an institutional partnership: write to us or use the Contribute page.
pages.contributeLede: Missing a past paper, a tutorial sheet or a model answer? Submit it: every document is reviewed before publication, then filed under its faculty, level and year. You can be credited by name.

terms.title: Acceptance of these terms
terms.body: By using Campusly you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, do not use the platform.

terms.title: Use of the service
terms.body: Campusly is intended for students of the University of Abomey-Calavi. The platform is to be used for legitimate academic purposes; accounts are personal.

terms.title: Content and contributions
terms.body: Submitted past papers must be legitimate academic documents. Any inappropriate, unauthorised or misleading content is removed. Moderation remains human.

terms.title: Personal data
terms.body: Only the data needed to operate the platform is collected (student number, faculty, usage history). You may request deletion of your account at any time.

terms.title: Premium subscription
terms.body: Credit packs are not open: no payment is accepted in this version and no price is published.

terms.title: Limitation of liability
terms.body: Campusly provides resources as they are. The accuracy and completeness of past papers are not guaranteed.

legal.termsContactBody: For any question, use the page

privacy.title: 1. Data collected
privacy.intro: Campusly collects the following information when you register and use the service:

items.text: UAC student number, faculty and department.
quiz history, progress, papers viewed and forum messages.

privacy.title: 2. How your data is used
privacy.intro: Your data is used exclusively to:

items.text: Personalise your experience (past-paper suggestions from your faculty).
Track your academic progress in the dashboard.
Manage your subscription and payments through our partner FedaPay.

Passwords are hashed server-side. No personal data is resold. In this current version, no data leaves your browser: what you enter stays in local storage and can be erased at any time from the settings.
You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. Account deletion will be available from the dashboard settings.
For any question about your data, email us or reach us on WhatsApp.
